title: Contents hit or miss. Some months suck. Bad value for money
text:
I appreciate the "discovery" aspect of this however I can't really give it anything more than 3 stars overall simply because it is VERY VERY BAD VALUE for what it costs.

Contents are hit or miss. Some months are REALLY bad and (to be slightly hyperbolic) their contents deserve to go directly in the trash.

To Bokksu: Reduce the price or increase the contents (by volume and weight) of the box.
label: neutral
